defaults.composition: One main texture of leaves, moss, fronds or blossom fills most of the frame at a natural close range, with the woodland behind softly out of focus but still readable; the camera sits level with the subject.

shots.subject: Fresh beech leaves unfolding on a low branch in a spring wood, pale green and slightly translucent, with the misty woodland and grey trunks softly blurred behind.
Young fern fronds uncurling from a mossy bank on the woodland floor, with sunlit woodland and white birch trunks softly blurred behind.
Hazel catkins hanging from thin twigs at the edge of a wood in warm low light, with the green woodland blurred into soft shapes behind.
A thick cushion of green moss on a fallen log with small wood sorrel leaves growing through it, soft grey-green trunks blurred behind.
Raindrops hanging from the tips of young birch leaves on a low branch in a spring wood, with the wet woodland softly blurred behind.
shots.motion_elements: the birch leaves and the hanging raindrops

shots.subject: White wood anemone flowers among dewy grass at the edge of a woodland path, with a pale glow among the soft blurred trees behind.
shots.motion_elements: the anemone flowers and the grass

shots.subject: A low rowan branch with fresh feathery leaves in dappled sunlight, with blurred smooth beech trunks and a bright woodland behind.
Young bracken shoots and tall grass blades backlit by low warm light at a woodland edge, with soft blurred trees behind.
shots.motion_elements: the bracken shoots and the grass blades

shots.subject: Wild garlic leaves with small white star flowers on the woodland floor, with the shaded wood and pale trunks soft behind.
A thin trickle of rainwater running over green moss on a woodland stone, with wet ferns and dark trunks blurred behind.
Thin mist drifting past a mossy oak trunk, a twig of fresh small leaves in front of it and a pale woodland soft behind.
shots.motion_elements: the drifting mist and the fresh leaves

shots.subject: A primrose clump on a mossy woodland bank, pale yellow flowers among crinkled leaves, with the sunny wood blurred behind.
A spray of white hawthorn blossom on a branch at the edge of a wood, lit by warm low sun, with a soft green woodland background.
Bluebell stems scattered among broad green leaves at the base of a smooth beech trunk, with the quiet wood soft behind.
Wet lady fern fronds glistening beside a small woodland pool after rain, the still water reflecting the fresh canopy and blurred trees behind.
shots.motion_elements: the fern fronds and the pool reflection

shots.subject: Soft young larch tufts with fresh pale new needles on a slender twig at a woodland edge, with a misty pale hillside wood softly blurred behind.
